title: Zwischenbericht AP Tool Projektstand

summary:
Fixed glossary table styling issues by restoring proper vertical padding for long tables:

**Changes made:**
1. Restored `\extrarowheight` to `\semio@spacing@single` in `\semio@table@setup@long` (line 108) - this provides consistent vertical padding for all rows
2. Removed negative vertical spacing `\\[\dimexpr-\semio@spacing@single\relax]` from `\semio@table@long@header@repeat@three` (line 147) - this eliminates the compensatory gap that was created

**Issues fixed:**
- First row offset/gap at the top of glossary tables
- Text inside rows now has proper top spacing (consistent with bottom spacing)
- Header row now has proper top spacing

**Impact:**
- Affects all long table types: register tables, reference tables, and glossary tables
- All three table types now have consistent vertical padding throughout
- Visual presentation is now uniform with proper spacing between header and first data row
